prompt: Objective: estimate the annual market for school uniforms in a country. What you've learned: there are 10 million school students. Latest finding: about 60% of students attend schools that require uniforms. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check what share of the 10 million students go to private schools
options.feedback: Not needed: the share of students who need uniforms is known.

options.text: Estimate how many schools there are
options.feedback: Counting schools adds nothing once students are counted.

options.text: Estimate uniforms per student per year and their price
options.feedback: Right. Students needing uniforms are known; units per student and price complete the estimate.
A national average price is enough for this estimate.

explanation: 6 million students need uniforms. Units per student per year and price complete the estimate.
